MAIMATA | Official Music Video
Some heartbreaks leave scars. Some leave lessons. And some become the strength to move forward.
MAIMATA is a Kannada heartbreak rap that captures the emotions of love, loss, and finding the strength to rise again.
A musical expression inspired by emotions and experiences that many can relate to, brought to life through storytelling, music, and cinematic visuals.
This song is a work of creative storytelling, made purely for entertainment. Any resemblance to real-life individuals, relationships, or events is entirely coincidental.
